name: Tracy Burns
office: Water Replenishment District of Southern California, Member, Board of Directors, Division 3

items.text: Tracy Burns is a retired Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department sergeant and businesswoman. Her campaign says she supports fiscal discipline and reducing dependence on imported water. She says data centers can create jobs but that ratepayers should not pay for their infrastructure or water supply costs.
